rules: Keep payment text, labels, states, price math, discount rules, CTA labels, and validation behavior aligned with the current payment popup.
Use these variants for visual review only; do not port into React or replace live checkout without explicit design approval.
External references are mechanics only, not copied assets/layouts.
Never copy textual labels or presentation copy from visual references into payment prototypes. Visible text must come from the current payment source or be directly relevant to AIM/payment review.

A review variant must have a material design delta: composition, hierarchy, interaction, motion mechanic, content model, state behavior, or source-mechanic fidelity. A background/accent/pseudo-element-only skin is not a separate design.
If two variants share the same structural shell, keep at most two for comparison and explain the exact difference in reviewFocus/designDelta before sending to Sonya or Page Design Lab.
